items.problem: Packaged WinUI 3 app builds clean but fails AppX registration with 0x80080204 because the copied Package.appxmanifest keeps UWP windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint extensions with no windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer registration. App never launches → 0/100.
items.evidence: migration-score.json winui_launch_error (0x80080204, Package.appxmanifest line 31, EntryPoint=BackgroundTask.GeofenceBackgroundTask); discrepancies.md 'Blocking defect'; skill grep for backgroundTask/activatableClass → no matches.
items.root_cause: The migration skill has no coverage of UWP background-task manifest extensions and no validator/checklist step to reconcile them; the manifest checklist implied TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust were the complete set.
items.change: Added Section 5c to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: statically FAILs when Package.appxmanifest contains <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks"> without a windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer registration, naming the 0x80080204 cause and both fixes. Can't be ignored — it fails the gate before launch.
items.expected_effect: The clean-build-but-unlaunchable manifest is caught at validation time; the agent removes the block(s) (or adds the inProcessServer class) and the app registers and launches.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 emits '[FAIL] … windows.backgroundTasks … 0x80080204' for the copied manifest; after the fix the app launches (winui_launchable=true) and the 8 scenarios become reachable (score > 0).

items.problem: Manifest migration checklist reads as complete after 3 attribute fixes, so the agent left background-task extensions in place; skill has no prose describing the WinUI 3 background-task manifest difference.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Manifest migration checklist' items 1-4 only; SKILL.md healthcheck bullet 5 listed only image refs/target/rescap/runFullTrust.
items.root_cause: Skill-defect (absent content) + coverage-gap (checklist implied completeness). Tier 1 alone can catch it, but the agent needs the fix recipe to act on the FAIL.
items.change: Added checklist item 5 'Reconcile UWP <Extension> blocks — especially windows.backgroundTasks' to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md with the 0x80080204 error, the remove-by-default fix, and the inProcessServer full-fidelity option; extended SKILL.md healthcheck bullet 5 to name the background-task extension and link the checklist.
items.expected_effect: The agent has a concrete recipe when the validator FAILs, and the checklist no longer implies completeness after only 3 attribute edits.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, the agent removes/reconciles the background-task extension and the manifest passes Validate Section 5c; no 0x80080204 at launch.
